gate: FINAL-004 consolidated release matrix (replaces the Phase 8 aggregate evidence)
tree_under_test: ed756a9 + the matrix-found CSS fixes committed immediately after this run
method: one scripted real-browser pass (.playwright-mcp/final_release_matrix.js); alert() stubbed as a recorder via addInitScript before navigation; pageerror + console-error listeners attached before first goto
zoom_equivalence: WCAG 1.4.10 reflow: 640px width == 200% zoom at 1280; 320px width == 400% zoom at 1280. Zoom is therefore covered by the width matrix, not per-route zoom emulation.

results.console_errors: 3, all the browser's own resource-load messages for the deliberately-visited 400/404 error-state probes; zero on normal routes

error_states.note: no 403/503 surfaces exist: the app has no auth layer or upstream proxy; 400 + 404 are its real error states

anchor_visibility_390px.note: section-nav is static below the desktop breakpoint (pills wrap to content-dependent rows); scroll-padding-top clears the sticky header

defects_found_by_this_gate_and_fixed: auto-fit minmax(320px) grids forced 320px columns at the 320px stress width (44px document overflow on the three section-nav routes); all auto-fit grids now use minmax(min(Xpx, 100%), 1fr)
help-icon buttons were 16px tap targets (20 on ticker detail); now 24px boxes per WCAG 2.5.8 with the same glyph
sticky section-nav wrapped to ~107px tall at phone widths and covered its own anchor targets; it is static below the desktop breakpoint with token-driven scroll-padding for the sticky header
qa_infrastructure_note: single-threaded wsgiref wedges when Chrome opens speculative preconnect sockets that never send a request (accept()+recv() blocks forever); browser gates run the server via .playwright-mcp/serve_with_socket_timeout.py (socket default timeout 5s, gitignored, zero production change)
not_statically_claimed: malformed-HTML validity is covered by the pytest HTMLParser structural guards, not this gate; composited/inherited color combinations are reviewed here visually, only self-colored selectors are statically contrast-checked
